mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reduces discount rates for equity cash flows and stimulates risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3mo_MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annualized) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as aggressive rate hikes compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL above 3.5% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 3-month moving average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it reflects expanding manufacturing output and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate immediate central bank intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) above its 3-month moving average and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below its 3-month moving average signal a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS above 3mo_MA and UNRATE below 3mo_MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, rising HOUST fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.
